creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`52dfca8b` shipped nested commands and named this as a known rough edge, pinned by snapshots so that fixing it shows up as a reviewable diff. Rewriting `remind` onto command blocks hit it on the first try: the help for a namespace tells the reader to type something that does not work.

```
$ remind agent --help
Usage:
  agent [command] [OPTIONS]        <- `agent` on its own is not a command
```

Every level below the root drops its ancestry. `core/testing/snapshots/args/nested_cmds.snap` already pins all three shapes:

| line | renders | should read |
|---|---|---|
| 145 | `remote [command] [OPTIONS]` | `TestCase remote [command] [OPTIONS]` |
| 192 | `remote [command] [OPTIONS]` | `TestCase remote [command] [OPTIONS]` |
| 232 | `add <name> <url> [OPTIONS]` | `TestCase remote add <name> <url> [OPTIONS]` |

The root's own line (273) is correct, so this is only about the path prefix. Line 145 is the "Must specify a command for 'remote'" error, which makes it the worst of the three: the one moment the reader has already been told they got the invocation wrong is the moment we hand them another one that will not parse.

### Orientation

The fix is upstream in ra. Rad only prints the string it is given.

- `ra_usage.go:441` `generateSynopsis` renders the leading name as `c.name`, the command's own name, with no ancestry.
- `generateSynopsisAs(name, ...)` directly below it already accepts an arbitrary leading name. It exists so a parent can render its default sub-command's line. The rendering half is therefore done; what is missing is knowing the path.
- `Cmd` (`ra_cmd.go:34`) holds `subCmds` but no link back to its parent, so a sub-command cannot currently derive its own path. Either record the parent at registration, or thread the accumulated prefix down through the usage walk.

### Watch out for

- The synopsis is reached from at least three entry points: a namespace's `-h`, a leaf's `-h`, and the missing-command error. Fixing the help path alone leaves the error path wrong, and that is the one users actually hit.
- `generateSynopsisAs` also renders the `(same as: ...)` line for a default command, where it deliberately substitutes the *parent's* name. Any change assuming "leading name == full path" breaks that line.
- Rad pins ra by version, so this needs an ra release before rad can take it, same as `a_2628oiwMF`.

The sibling rough edge `52dfca8b` called out in the same breath, a namespace's shared args rendering under "Global options" rather than as its own args, is not carded anywhere. Worth deciding whether it rides along with this.
title: Nested commands drop their path from the usage line - needs an ra release
